native_behavior: Complete event input types vary by operation; the existing method body sees only the projected subset.
declarative_requirement: Explicit typed full-intent declaration and knownness/applicability requirements.

native_behavior: Chronology, exact input population, types, provenance, unknown and false approval are checked before specialization.
declarative_requirement: Keep this boundary and failure status before template evaluation.

native_behavior: Empty opening claim map, map capacity, typed memory, role mapping and explicit policy are baseline scope.
declarative_requirement: Do not silently generalize opening population or accounting authority.

native_behavior: Claim id/customer/due and event id/date specialize insertion path and row constants; duplicate and due-date eligibility precede construction.
declarative_requirement: Typed metadata/value binding, explicit guarded declarations and dynamic path segments.

native_behavior: Selected claim lookup checks ownership, constructs an escaped remaining pointer, then extends preconditions, monetary calculation and write.
declarative_requirement: Typed map lookup with exact failure, safe pointer construction and complete explicit method template.

native_behavior: Date-window/cursor checks construct a state-only method, then one set of writes per current claim with overdue selection and sequential operation ids.
declarative_requirement: Bounded declared map iteration, explicit ordering, date relations and exact guarded template values.

native_behavior: The memory-input schema derives from the exact emitted input types and its digest enters the method.
declarative_requirement: Reuse the pinned schema compiler after data construction; do not expose arbitrary callbacks.

native_behavior: Final request binds actual current book, full event, full method, schema population and memory definition.
declarative_requirement: Recompute digests from complete objects; refuse stale state or contract.

native_behavior: Claim sums, dates, sale references and assessment snapshots constrain accepted states.
declarative_requirement: Already authored through explicit invariant source; retain without rebuilding.

native_behavior: Original transition, report and carry evaluators compute actual results.
declarative_requirement: Reuse them as explicit baseline evaluators; a template is not accounting admission.
